title: Uniform functions and independent outputs
statement: Let $\\iota$, $\\alpha$, and $\\beta$ be finite sets, with $\\alpha$ nonempty, and let $\\varphi_i:\\alpha\\to\\beta$ be given for each $i\\in\\iota$. Choose a function $a:\\iota\\to\\alpha$ uniformly and map it to the function $i\\mapsto\\varphi_i(a(i))$. Its distribution is the product, over $i\\in\\iota$, of the distributions obtained by choosing uniformly from $\\alpha$ and applying $\\varphi_i$.
hypotheses_covered: a map $\\varphi_i:\\alpha\\to\\beta$ is given for each $i\\in\\iota$
